name: calldiff
tagline: AST-based diff of call stacks between git commits, in 22 languages
description: calldiff computes an AST-based diff of call stacks between git commits across 22 languages via Tree-sitter. Rather than showing a blob-level diff, it surfaces exactly which functions and call paths changed, giving reviewers a far more precise view of an agent's edits. It was purpose-built for agentic code review, where understanding the ripple effects of a change matters more than ever.
highlights: AST-based call-stack diffing between git commits
Surfaces changed functions and call paths, not just raw blobs
curatorNote: Reviewing an agent's changes by eyeballing diffs is a losing game. calldiff's call-stack-aware diffing is exactly the kind of tooling agentic review has been missing.
